clips.title: The story
paras: Lorekeeper Raintotem is a tauren elder stationed in northern Mulgore just south of Red Rocks. He tends to the sacred burial grounds and asks adventurers to drive off the Bristleback quilboar disturbing them.

Positioned near the sacred bluffs of Red Rocks in Mulgore, Lorekeeper Raintotem tends to the spiritual obligations of his people. He asks adventurers to drive Bristleback Interlopers from the burial ground, restoring peace to the ancestors' resting place.

Beyond testing fledgling heroes, Lorekeeper Raintotem watches over the hallowed burial sites at Red Rocks. When Bristleback quilboar interlopers disturb the sanctified resting places of deceased tauren chieftains and shamans, Raintotem enlists travelers to restore dignity and quiet the disturbed dead.
